## Krea 2 Turbo - Text-to-Image + Clio Style Library

This is the Krea 2 Turbo step-LoRA text-to-image workflow, upgraded with the **Clio Style Library** node. Pick a style from its dropdown (~281 built-in art styles) and the node injects a full style description straight into your prompt, so you get consistent images in that look without hand-writing the style each time.

Runs with both the **2-step and 4-step** Krea 2 Turbo distillation LoRAs (by lvladikov) for very fast generations.

### The Clio Style node (manual install - not in Manager yet)
Node by **lumenastrum**: https://github.com/lumenastrum/clio-style-preview

It's **not in ComfyUI Manager yet**, so install it by hand. From your ComfyUI folder:
`cd ComfyUI/custom_nodes`
`git clone https://github.com/lumenastrum/clio-style-preview clio-style-node`

The **Show Text** nodes (ComfyUI-Custom-Scripts by pythongosssss) print the exact styled prompt the Clio node built, so you always see what's actually being sent to the model.

Styles stay true to their target most of the time. A few miss - usually fixable with a bit more prompt detail - but overall it holds the look well.

### Files (this workflow's defaults)
- [krea2_turbo_fp8.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/AlperKTS/Krea2_FP8/tree/main) -> `models/diffusion_models/` (or a [GGUF quant](https://huggingface.co/vantagewithai/Krea-2-Turbo-GGUF/tree/main) -> `models/unet/`)
- [qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen3-VL/tree/main/text_encoders) -> `models/text_encoders/`
- [qwen_image_vae.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image_ComfyUI/tree/main/split_files/vae) -> `models/vae/`
- Turbo LoRA -> `models/loras/`: [2-step](https://huggingface.co/lvladikov/Krea2-Turbo-Distill-2step-LoRA/tree/main) or [4-step](https://huggingface.co/lvladikov/Krea2-Turbo-Distill-4step-LoRA/tree/main) rank-64 comfyui build

Set the CLIPLoader **type to `krea2`**.

### Settings
- **steps 2** (2-step LoRA) or **4** (4-step LoRA), **cfg 1.0** (Turbo is CFG-free)
- sampler **euler**, scheduler **sgm_uniform**, LoRA strength **1.0**
- Negative is a `ConditioningZeroOut` - nothing to write at cfg 1.0
- FP8 default + GGUF loader path - toggle with the Fast Groups Bypasser
- Upscale nodes included for a clean high-res pass

### Custom nodes
- **Clio Style Library** - lumenastrum/clio-style-preview (git clone, not in Manager yet)
- **ComfyUI-Custom-Scripts** (Show Text) - pythongosssss/ComfyUI-Custom-Scripts
- ComfyUI-GGUF, rgthree-comfy

Node by **lumenastrum**, turbo LoRAs by **lvladikov** - credit to both.
